lines.text: Many learners say: You are a teacher, isn't it?
Better: You are a teacher, aren't you?
Repeat the verb and the person.
Aren't you! You are tired, aren't you?

data.wrong: You are a teacher, isn't it?
data.right: You are a teacher, aren't you?
data.why: Repeat the verb and the person.

native.hook: 句尾提问不能固定说 isn't it！
native.tip: 中文的“是不是”“对吧”一个说法通用，所以容易总说 isn't it。英语要跟着前面的句子变。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “You are a teacher, isn't it?”😅 中文的“是不是”通用，英语的句尾提问要跟着前面的句子变：“You are a teacher, aren't you?”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“You are a teacher, aren't you?”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese has one ending for all, but English changes it with the sentence.
en.caption: Do you say “You are a teacher, isn't it?” 😅 English changes the ending question with the sentence: “You are a teacher, aren't you?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
